test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Dheeraj can cover a certain distance in 5 hours and 22 minutes by covering three-fourth of the distance at 5 km/h and the rest at 6 km/h. Find the total distance covered by him.
solution:
**Given**

Time = 5 hours and 22 minutes

3/4th distance covered with speed of 5 km/h

1/4th distance covered with speed of 6 km/h

**Formula used**

Time = Distance/speed

**Calculation**

Let the distance is x km

Time = 5{22over60}

⇒ 5{11over30}

⇒ 161over30 hours

3x/4 km distance covered with speed 5 km/h

x/4 km i.e. [x - (3x/4)] distance covered with speed 6 km/h

According to question

[(3x/4)/(5)] + [(x/4)/6] = 161/30

⇒ (3x/20) + (x/24) = 161/30

⇒ (18x + 5x)/120 = 161/30

⇒ 23x/120 = 161/30

⇒ x = (161 × 120)/(30 × 23)

⇒ x = 28 km

**∴ The total distance covered by Dheeraj is 28 km.**
